cause.observed: Both native success fixtures abort at their source-origin guards before the callback observations run. The identical custom RuntimeException appears for cached and uncached variants.
cause.inference_from_immutable_source: Each guard compares a realpath() result to realpath($argv[2]) concatenated with a forward-slash suffix. Windows returns native backslash paths; the RHS keeps a mixed-separator suffix and strict equality rejects the intended checkout. Actual compared path operands were not printed in this failing run.

evidence.retrieval: Public GitHub REST run/job metadata via urllib; decoded complete job log via github_fetch_workflow_job_logs connector. Log saved as UTF-8 preserving the returned BOM, ANSI sequences and CRLF.
